verdict.rationale: Missive's AI Assistant/MCP integration explicitly supports agent-driven triage ('Let an agent triage new conversations against your CRM before you look at them'), inbox summarization, and rule-based automation (up to 1000 rules), and provides audit trails via action logs and a session tab showing assistant activity, plus permission-scoped access for steering behavior. However, there's no explicit mention of automatic labeling/categorization as a distinct AI feature (only manual rules), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming triage quality works as advertised. Missing for 10: explicit auto-labeling/categorization feature description, hands-on validation of triage accuracy, and clearer UI for reviewing/adjusting AI triage decisions beyond session logs.
